result.summary: E2E tests for Stage F2 (PD-UI-01 through PD-UI-04): 7 passed / 6 failed. Blockers: PD-UI-01 search filter mismatch, PD-UI-02 variable typo, PD-UI-03 inline expand not implemented (click navigates to editor), PD-UI-04 disabled submit button + backend POST /definitions error.

issues.description: Search filter returns no results for matching definition name. Backend search behavior mismatch.
ReferenceError: def is not defined — typo: variable is 'draftDef' but test references 'def'.
Clicking definition name navigates to /definitions/{id} editor page instead of expanding version history inline. version-history-row element does not exist.
Same as TC-PDUI03-01 — expand/collapse model not implemented; clicking name navigates to editor.
Submit button is disabled when name field is empty; Playwright cannot click disabled element.
POST /api/v1/definitions returns error — 'Failed to create definition' shown in dialog. Backend rejects creation request.
